units.source_text: 源氏公子所住的地方，是靠边一个房间。

en.t: The place where Prince Genji was staying was a room off to one side.

units.source_text: 他亲自开门，和夕颜一同出去观赏外面的景色。

en.t: He opened the door himself and went out with Yugao to look at the view outside.

units.source_text: 这狭小的庭院里，种着几竿萧疏的淡竹，

en.t: In the small courtyard grew a few sparse stalks of pale bamboo,

units.source_text: 花木上的露珠同宫中的一样，映着晓月，闪闪发光。

en.t: and the dew on the flowering trees, just like in the palace, reflected the dawn moon and glittered.

units.source_text: 秋虫唧唧，到处乱鸣。

en.t: Autumn insects chirped noisily, calling in confusion from every side.

units.source_text: 源氏公子在宫中时，屋宇宽广，即使是壁间蟋蟀之声，听来也很远。

en.t: When Prince Genji was in the palace, the buildings were so spacious that even the sound of crickets in the walls seemed far away.

units.source_text: 现在这些虫声竟像从耳边响出，他觉得有异样之感。

en.t: Now the insects seemed to be sounding right beside his ears, and the strangeness of it struck him.

units.source_text: 只因对夕颜的恩爱十分深重，一切缺点都蒙原谅了。

en.t: Because his love for Yugao was so deep, every shortcoming was forgiven.

units.source_text: 夕颜身穿白色夹衫，罩上一件柔软的淡紫色外衣。

en.t: Yugao wore a white lined robe, with a soft pale purple outer garment over it.

units.source_text: 装束并不华丽，却有娇艳之姿。

en.t: Her clothing was not splendid, yet she had a delicate and alluring beauty.

units.source_text: 她身上并无显然可指的优点，然而体态轻盈袅娜，妩媚动人。

en.t: There was no obvious excellence one could point to in her, yet her figure was light and graceful, charming and deeply appealing.

units.source_text: 一言一语，都使人觉得可怜。

en.t: Every word she spoke made one feel tenderness and pity for her.

units.source_text: 真是个异常可爱的人物。

en.t: She truly was an exceptionally lovable person.

units.source_text: 源氏公子觉得最好再稍稍添加些刚强之心。

en.t: Prince Genji thought it would be better if she had just a little more strength of heart.

units.source_text: 他想和她无拘无束地畅谈，便对她说：“我们现在就到附近一个地方去，

en.t: Wanting to talk with her freely and without restraint, he said to her, "Let us go now to some nearby place,

units.source_text: 自由自在地谈到明天吧。

en.t: and talk as freely as we like until tomorrow.

units.source_text: 一直住在这里，真教人苦闷。”

en.t: Staying here all the time is truly stifling."

units.source_text: 夕颜不慌不忙地答道：“为什么这样呢？

en.t: Yugao answered calmly, "Why must it be like that?

units.source_text: 太匆促吧！”

en.t: Is it not too sudden?"

units.source_text: 源氏公子对她立了山盟海誓，订了来世之约，夕颜便真心信任，开诚相待，其态度异常天真，不像一个已婚的女子。

en.t: Prince Genji swore solemn vows to her and promised a bond in the life to come, so Yugao trusted him sincerely and opened her heart to him, with a manner so innocent that she did not seem like a married woman.

units.source_text: 此时源氏公子顾不得人之多言了，便召唤侍女右近出来，吩咐她去叫随从把车子赶进门内。

en.t: By this time Prince Genji no longer cared what people might say, so he called the maid Ukon out and told her to have the attendants bring the carriage inside the gate.

units.source_text: 住在这里的别的侍女知道源氏公子的爱情非寻常可比，虽然因为不明公子身份而略感不安，还是信赖他，由他把女主人带去。

en.t: The other maids living there knew that Prince Genji's love was no ordinary thing; though they felt a little uneasy because they did not know his identity, they trusted him and let him take their mistress away.
